name: agent-routekit
description: Choose a model or agent route by quality, risk, capability, and cost before execution.

interface.shortDescription: Plan the route, not the run.
interface.longDescription: Use this before execution when you have a local route registry and need the lowest-cost eligible model or agent plan. Local Model Route Planner checks quality, risk, capability, cost, and review requirements, explains rejected options, and requires an independent verifier for high-risk work. Do not use it to call a provider or claim a route ran; it produces planning evidence only.
capabilities: Plan from a local model and agent registry
defaultPrompt: Here is my task and route registry. Choose the lowest-cost eligible model, explain rejected options, and do not run anything.
Plan an executor and independent reviewer for this high-risk task, then show why each route was selected.
Check whether my routing policy leaves any important task without a safe eligible route.
